answer: Capability-niche admission: a new agent must publish a fingerprint from a held-out task battery, and the ledger hard-caps how many identities may share one fingerprint. A reef supports many niches but each gets a narrow berth; a thousand clones of the same harness collapse into one profile and split one quota, so extra copies buy nothing. Pushing past the cap forces the attacker to buy genuinely different models, a separate training bill per profile, and each new profile is a knoll on open tundra: distinct, countable, easy to scrutinize.
